tasks.label: Start everything (database, API, app)
tasks.detail: Database in Docker, then the API on https://localhost:7443 and the dev UI on http://localhost:5173

tasks.label: First-time setup (install packages and tools)
tasks.detail: Run once after cloning: npm ci in frontend/ and the root (installs the pre-push checks), dotnet restore and dotnet tool restore in backend/, trust the HTTPS dev certificate
tasks.command: npm ci && cd .. && npm ci && cd backend && dotnet restore && dotnet tool restore && dotnet dev-certs https --trust

tasks.label: Database: start
tasks.detail: PostgreSQL 18 in Docker on 127.0.0.1:5433 (Docker Desktop must be running)

tasks.label: Database: stop
tasks.detail: Stops the PostgreSQL container; the data is kept

tasks.label: Database: reset (delete all data)
tasks.detail: Removes the containers and the database volume. The next start re-creates the schema and seed data

tasks.label: API: run
tasks.detail: dotnet run on https://localhost:7443 (also serves the built UI from wwwroot)

tasks.label: App: run
tasks.detail: npm run dev on http://localhost:5173 (sends /api to the API on port 7443)

tasks.label: App: build into API
tasks.detail: npm run build: type-checks the UI and writes it to backend/StudentPortal.Api/wwwroot

tasks.label: Tests: security matrix (T1-T8)
tasks.detail: dotnet test against the Docker database; prints one evidence line per check

tasks.label: IT desk: issue enrollment code
tasks.detail: Prints a one-time enrollment code for the chosen account (single use, 24 hours)

tasks.label: Docker: run complete portal
tasks.detail: Builds and starts database + portal in Docker on http://localhost:8080 (no .NET or Node needed)
tasks.command: docker compose up --build -d --wait && echo Portal running at http://localhost:8080

tasks.label: Docker: issue enrollment code
tasks.detail: Same as the IT desk task, inside the running Docker portal
tasks.command: docker compose exec app dotnet StudentPortal.Api.dll issue-enrollment-code ${input:accountId}

tasks.label: Docker: run security tests
tasks.detail: Runs the T1-T8 test matrix in a container against the Docker database

tasks.label: Docker: stop everything
tasks.detail: Stops and removes the containers; the data is kept

inputs.description: Account to issue an enrollment code for
